Playgrounds · 23 labs · offline · no key

Play the mechanism.

These labs use fixed teaching numbers so you can see a step change. They do not call a model. The quiz has 311 questions and a 20-question boss exam. Each lab says why the step matters before you move on.

Proof record

Why it matters. Later tracks only count if you can show the run, the trace, the metric, and the file.

Fill in all four fields. The metric needs a number.

Temperature and top-p

Why it matters. Sampling changes which token is likely. It does not add a fact.

The logits are fixed teaching numbers. A shipping model has a much larger vocabulary.

Embedding space

Why it matters. Nearby points share direction. A query far from every note should refuse, not guess.

3D vector space. Orbit the clusters, then move the amber query. A browser without WebGL keeps the flat map below.

Hold Shift and click the space to place the query, or use the sliders. Cosine is measured from the center in three dimensions. At z = 50 the third component is zero.

Prompt diff

Why it matters. A prompt you cannot diff is a prompt you cannot improve.

    Memory fit

    Why it matters. A model that does not fit does not run, and a tight fit leaves no room for context.

    This is weights only. The runtime and the context window sit on top.

    Cost and latency

    Why it matters. A call you cannot price is a bill you will meet later.

    Context packing

    Why it matters. The window is one budget. A long extra document can push out the answer.

    Toy budget: 100 tokens. Keep the question, the refund policy, and the answer reserve. Leave the rest out if they do not fit.

    Vector index

    Why it matters. An index is a choice about which points you are willing to skip.

    Function-call check

    Why it matters. The model proposes the call. Your code accepts it only when the JSON matches.

    {"name":"lookup_note","arguments":{"topic":"refund | shipping | hours"}}

    Multi-agent handoff

    Why it matters. Another agent helps only when it receives an artifact it can check.

      MCP permissions

      Why it matters. The protocol carries the call. It does not decide that the call is allowed.
